tasks.name: Run context-aware continuation judge at premature stops
tasks.description: Source continuation-context.sh before GBTW_TEST_MODE early return. Expose continuation prompt/schema through sourceable helper for real grader tests. Prompt question: Does authorized work remain that the assistant can do now? Require D/F reason name specific authorized available next action; A/B completed request or explicit pause or genuine blocking decision/approval/wait with no independent work. Substantive design is work; do not require implementation during brainstorming. Optional questions, promises, irrelevant tools and mere wait prose cannot establish completion. Missing/truncated context is uncertainty, never proof of no activity. Preserve untrusted-data fencing. In run_check select normalized continuation context only for check_name continuation; other graders retain RECENT_CONTEXT. Remove brainstorming, execution_complete, in-flight/wait-tool and holding-prose blanket suppression of continuation. Preserve deterministic task/review gates, review-wait helper behavior, forced-turn bypass handling, activation-only behavior, validator-error fail-open, existing three-block/five-minute escape, wrappers and grades. Fix regression tests that encode superseded continuation suppression while retaining tests of helpers still used by deterministic gates. In earlier submitted/pending/in-progress task branches, preserve deferral of deterministic review/task block but remove approve-and-exit on live job/wait evidence: retain evidence and fall through to continuation judge. Do not fall into unconditional task block after deferral. Keep deterministic blocks when no legitimate deferral signal exists. Add actual task-row routing tests for submitted and pending/in-progress: unrelated live job with independent work reaches judge and blocks; genuine dependency wait reaches judge and passes. Existing review-gate test expectations may require transport stub with legitimate wait grade A, never network dependency.

steps.description: RED: extend focused regression tests before implementation. Assert D/F native Codex block and Claude protocol, completed A allows, validator failure allows with explicit failure reason, throttle still bounds retries. Preserve existing in-flight/wait/review-gate tests. Add opt-in --live mode to focused test using actual call_validation_llm and actual continuation prompt/schema; cases: promise-only brainstorming, optional question with independent work, irrelevant tool then promise => D/F; necessary design choice, completed no-tool answer, operator pause, required approval, genuine dependency wait => A/B. Record raw grades/reasons, backend config identity and transport failures in validation artifact; no mocked results presented as semantic validation. Exercise actual submitted and pending/in-progress task rows with deferred waits; ensure judge receives wait evidence and distinguishes remaining independent work. Capture available real Stop payload/transcript replay evidence and any unavailable native integration limitation.
Run regression commands; record observed failure and verify it demonstrates specified defect, not setup failure.
